description: Compare multiple solar cells side by side — power-conversion efficiency (PCE), raw power, and a coverage/ranking table. PCE is the fair comparison metric since it normalizes for cell area.

panels.title: Power Conversion Efficiency (PCE) — per cell
panels.description: PCE(%) = 1000 × P[mW] / (irradiance[W/m²] × area[cm²]) for each selected cell. MPP-tracking mode only, irradiance > $min_irr W/m². Server-side downsampled to the panel interval.

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    sc.name      AS cell_name,
    sc.area_cm2  AS area_cm2,
    mfc.measured_at AS t,
    mfc.power_mw AS power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
    AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
),
irr AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS t,
    AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND irradiance > $min_irr
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  p.t         AS time,
  p.cell_name AS metric,
  1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0) AS pce
FROM p
JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Power — per cell
panels.description: Raw MPP power for each selected cell (MPP-tracking mode), server-side downsampled to the panel interval. Not area-normalized — use PCE for fair comparison.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  mfc.measured_at AS time,
  sc.name         AS metric,
  mfc.power_mw    AS power
FROM solar_cell sc
CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms) mfc
WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
  AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average PCE Ranking
panels.description: Mean PCE per selected cell over the range (MPP-tracking mode, irradiance > $min_irr W/m²).

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT sc.name AS cell_name, sc.area_cm2,
    mfc.measured_at AS t, mfc.power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
    AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
),
irr AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS t, AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND irradiance > $min_irr
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.cell_name AS "Cell",
  AVG(1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) AS "Avg PCE"
FROM p JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
GROUP BY p.cell_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Comparison & Coverage
panels.description: Per-cell summary: average/peak PCE, average power, and data coverage. Ranked by average PCE. Coverage (first/last/days) is derived from the selected time range, not the cell's full history.

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT sc.name AS cell_name, sc.area_cm2,
    mfc.measured_at AS t, mfc.mode_code, mfc.power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
),
irr AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS t, AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND irradiance > $min_irr
  GROUP BY 1
),
cov AS (
  SELECT cell_name, MIN(t) AS first_data, MAX(t) AS last_data,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (t)::date) AS days_with_data
  FROM p GROUP BY cell_name
),
power_stats AS (
  SELECT cell_name, AVG(power_mw) AS avg_power
  FROM p WHERE mode_code = 'mpp_tracking' GROUP BY cell_name
),
pce_stats AS (
  SELECT p.cell_name,
    AVG(1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) AS avg_pce,
    MAX(1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) AS peak_pce
  FROM p JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
  WHERE p.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
  GROUP BY p.cell_name
)
SELECT
  cov.cell_name      AS "Cell",
  ps.avg_pce         AS "Avg PCE (%)",
  ps.peak_pce        AS "Peak PCE (%)",
  pw.avg_power       AS "Avg Power (mW)",
  cov.days_with_data AS "Days w/ Data",
  cov.first_data     AS "First Data",
  cov.last_data      AS "Last Data"
FROM cov
LEFT JOIN power_stats pw ON pw.cell_name = cov.cell_name
LEFT JOIN pce_stats   ps ON ps.cell_name = cov.cell_name
ORDER BY ps.avg_pce DESC NULLS LAST

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.definition:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '(all experiments)' AS __text, '__all__' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1, name, name FROM experiment
) e
ORDER BY ord, __text
list.query:

  SELECT 0 AS ord, '(all experiments)' AS __text, '__all__' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1, name, name FROM experiment
) e
ORDER BY ord, __text

list.name: cell
list.label: Solar Cells
list.definition:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '— none (select cells below) —' AS __text, '__none__' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1, sc.name, sc.name FROM solar_cell sc
  WHERE '$experiment' = '__all__'
     OR sc.id IN (
       SELECT sce.solar_cell_id
       FROM solar_cell_experiment sce
       JOIN experiment e ON e.id = sce.experiment_id
       WHERE e.name = '$experiment')
) s
ORDER BY ord, __text

list.label: Min Irradiance (W/m²)
list.description: Irradiance floor for PCE — measurements below this are excluded to suppress low-light noise.
